FAQ

Good questions.

How much does a move cost?

A 2-hour move with 2 movers starts around $330, and bigger crews and longer moves scale from there. Use the estimator above for a ballpark, then get your official quote free.

Do you do long-distance moves?

Yes. We move anywhere in Colorado and handle long-distance moves into and out of the state. Moves over 100 miles are quoted personally, and the same team leader loads and unloads your truck.

Can you just load my rental truck or POD?

Absolutely. If you're driving the truck yourself, we'll load or unload your rental truck, moving POD or shipping container, packed tight so nothing shifts.

Do you sell boxes and supplies?

Yes: small, medium, large and wardrobe boxes, plus mattress covers and moving pads. Our packing service includes tape, paper and labels.

Are you licensed?

Yes. Young Buck Moving operates under Colorado PUC permit HHG-00532.
